title: Canonical Feature Schema for WESAD ECG Stress Detection
description: Formal schema and physiological specifications for the canonical 445-window feature dataset derived from WESAD chest Lead-II ECG.

Subject.description: WESAD participant identifier (15 healthy adults: S2-S11, S13-S17; S1 and S12 excluded by study protocol).

Condition.description: Experimental protocol condition label (Baseline = seated neutral reading, Stress = Trier Social Stress Test TSST).

Window.description: Sequential window index within the condition for that subject.

MeanHR.description: Arithmetic mean of instantaneous heart rate across the 60-second window, HR_i = 60 / RR_i.

MedianHR.description: Median of instantaneous heart rate across the 60-second window.

StdHR.description: Standard deviation of instantaneous heart rate.

MinHR.description: Minimum instantaneous heart rate observed within the window.

MaxHR.description: Maximum instantaneous heart rate observed within the window.

MeanRR.description: Arithmetic mean of normal-to-normal RR intervals in seconds.

MedianRR.description: Median of normal-to-normal RR intervals in seconds.

SDNN.description: Standard deviation of normal-to-normal RR intervals (Task Force 1996 standard). Expressed in seconds in canonical CSV (0.0448 s = 44.8 ms).

RMSSD.description: Root mean square of successive RR interval differences, reflecting parasympathetic autonomic tone (Task Force 1996 standard). Expressed in seconds in canonical CSV (0.0312 s = 31.2 ms).

pNN50.description: Percentage of adjacent RR intervals that differ by more than 50 milliseconds.

RR_CV.description: Coefficient of variation of RR intervals: RR_CV = SDNN / MeanRR.

RR_IQR.description: Interquartile range (75th - 25th percentile) of RR intervals, providing robust dispersion insensitive to outlier beats.

HR_IQR.description: Interquartile range of instantaneous heart rate.

baseline_calibration_formula.description: Subject-specific relative fractional deviation centered around zero at rest.
baseline_calibration_formula.standardization: StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True) fitted strictly on training fold X_train and applied to test fold X_test with zero leakage.
